data.one_liner: macOS implementation of the file_selector plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to pick files, directories, and save locations on macOS. It implements the platform interface required by file_selector.
use_when: Need to select files or directories on macOS
Need to save a file location on macOS
Using file_selector in a Flutter app targeting macOS
avoid_when: Using only iOS or Android platforms
You already have a custom native implementation
strengths: Keeps up with latest Flutter SDKs
No extra pubspec dependency needed when using file_selector
weaknesses: Requires adding entitlements to the app bundle
data.setup_notes: Add the entitlement for read-only or read/write access in the macOS project’s Info.plist. No build_runner or codegen required.

alternatives.name: file_selector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform plugin that automatically pulls in the macOS implementation when used
